Definition: abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite)
BiblicalUsage: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them? The psalmist will not be afraid of ten thousands of people set against him round about, and the women sang that Saul had slain his thousands and David his ten thousands.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that ten thousand is the Bible's way of saying more than you can count, and God counts them all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
